exclusions.reason_for_seed_zero_rule: zero denotes the regular deterministic layout, not a shared stochastic disorder realization

coverage.calibration_exclusions: same complete case, same field lineage, and same equal nonzero disorder seed

descriptor_nearest_neighbour.meaning: Descriptor Nearest-Neighbour; never deep neural network

matched_random_baseline.k5_sensitivity: first five identities of the authoritative size-10 draw

k20_sensitivity_extension.candidate_pool: remaining permitted pool after removing the authoritative primary ten

matched_random_baseline.candidate_pool: same permitted outer-development pool; identical random identities for SS and MS

conditional_variance.local_estimator: unweighted trace sum of squared deviations from K-neighbor target mean divided by K-1
conditional_variance.development_total_variance: case-equal mean target second norm minus squared case-equal mean target vector

polynomial_ridge.mso_mapping_note: Only deployment-available pre-frozen columns are used; eig_ratio, rho, and local_dv_rms are the registered MSO invariant equivalents. kh is absent and is not added. Both arms use the identical seven-column subset. The target-blind numerical preflight rejected lambda-one density-rate because its frozen IQR creates a degree-two normal-equation condition loss; local_dv_rms is the prospectively frozen velocity-gradient-scale equivalent.

nested_selection.inner_validation_folds: each of the five existing development outer-fold IDs once
nested_selection.inner_training_folds: the other four development outer-fold IDs
nested_selection.loss: equal mean over five inner folds of equal mean over four family NRMSE values
nested_selection.inner_target_rms: uncentered RMS from the corresponding four inner-training folds, case-equal and family-equal
nested_selection.failure: candidate invalid if any inner fold/family is nonfinite; all invalid makes oracle NOT_EVALUABLE
nested_selection.outer_refit: winner fit once on all five development folds; no heldout target selects winner

outer_metrics.formal_nrmse: equal mean over 6 folds and 4 families

aggregation.formal_order: particle_to_complete_case; equal cases within family/fold; equal four families; equal six folds
aggregation.relative_ratio: ratio of arm formal aggregates; never mean of case/fold ratios
aggregation.worst_family: maximum across the four family NRMSE formal aggregates

bootstrap.decode: replicate_offsets slice is a duplicated formal_case_index multiset; preserve multiplicities and never unique
bootstrap.recompute: only aggregate already cross-fitted complete-case sufficient statistics
bootstrap.insufficient_lineage_rule: point population requires >=6 lineages per family and every fold represented

studentization.standard_error: sample standard deviation of valid bootstrap estimates with ddof=1
studentization.quantile: nearest-rank ceil(0.95*B_valid)-1 on sorted values; clamp critical value at >=0
studentization.zero_se: if every draw equals point, contribution=0 and bound=point; otherwise NOT_EVALUABLE
studentization.scope: three primary components within each metric family
studentization.mixed_ratio_stability: unstable components are NOT_EVALUABLE; maximum studentization jointly spans all and only stable components, never separate pointwise bounds
studentization.worst_family: separate three-component max-studentized family per F1-F4; four-family intersection

numerical_ratio_and_auxiliary_gates.unstable_ratio_action: RELATIVE_GATE_NOT_EVALUABLE because no frozen absolute-difference noninferiority margin exists
numerical_ratio_and_auxiliary_gates.worst_family_guard: max_family_MS-max_family_SS<=0.05 and all MS family absolute gates pass
numerical_ratio_and_auxiliary_gates.coverage_guard: MS overall and every family pass absolute gates and each is no more than 0.05 below corresponding SS
numerical_ratio_and_auxiliary_gates.fold_reversal: fail component if any valid fold has MS>SS+dimensionless_floor simultaneously for DNN p90, conditional variance, and selected-oracle NRMSE

not_evaluable_propagation.required_fold: component NOT_EVALUABLE and six-fold gate invalid
not_evaluable_propagation.oracle_candidate_failure: candidate invalid only; no post-selection fallback
not_evaluable_propagation.global: any required component NOT_EVALUABLE makes global H-MSO-01 NOT_EVALUABLE and all downstream eligibility false
